description: Content attestation for guarded canon (COMP-CANON-GUARD S6): typed writers record a hash of what they produced; the ship-time scan compares every dirty guarded path against its last attested hash, so an interleaved tool-call-plus-hand-edit is detected. Until this lands the Bash bypass is a known, documented gap — S4's PreToolUse hook cannot see Bash/sed/git writes and S5's scan verifies THAT a tool ran, not WHAT it wrote.
